result.plainSummary: The simpler feature view keeps progress and problems visible while making proof easier to inspect.
result.summary: Independent review used related W013 pack: lattice feature and SL021/SL022 honest evidence, SL029 navigation and SL030 workflow placement. Bounded UI-only simplification preserves existing domain behavior. Acceptance requires visible current evidence counts and actionable failures, while details may expand; missing evidence and historical completion cannot become passing or complete by copy changes. Sol initial live audit and browser walkthrough complement rendered mixed-state tests; a text snapshot alone does not establish reduced navigation burden. Mapping names SL031, to be materialized with behavioral UI binding before verification. No new auth or execution boundary introduced.
residualRisks: Related tool supplied only a caution-only worktree note; sibling state was not treated as authority.
Rendered tests cannot establish usability alone; independent Sol observations and live walkthrough remain required.
